children: Churchill Capital Corp XIII reported net income in the quarter, driven by $2.46M of interest earned on trust-account investments, partly offset by $221,218 in general and administrative expenses. It has not yet begun operations and will not generate operating revenue until after a business combination.
: The company had not entered into a definitive agreement with a specific target as of September 30.
: The company completed its $414M initial public offering on August 3, including full exercise of the underwriter’s over-allotment option.
: $416.5M in marketable securities and cash was held in the trust account at September 30.
: The company has until August 3, 2028, to complete a business combination, subject to a possible extension.
